title: Pending wrap-ups
info: Who currently has an unfinished contact disposition.
windowNote: Live window, not a running total: an item disappears once it is closed or once the delegate deadline expires (24h + 1h by default). Period history lives in Analytics.
restricted: You do not have permission to view this page.
truncated: PARTIAL list — the scan cap was reached ({{scanned}} keys). Filter by pool or agent to see the rest.
directoryUnavailable: Names unavailable: your account lacks the config.usuarios field, so agents are shown by identifier.
searchPlaceholder: Search by agent, pool or session…
emptyHint: No wrap-up is waiting to be filled in right now.
emptyFiltered: No pending items match the current filters.
confirmExpire:
Close the pending item on session {{session}}… from {{agent}}?

The contact is left WITHOUT a disposition — a supervisor does not fill it in on the agent's behalf. The slot is released and the process moves on.

state.unclaimedHint: The item is in the queue and nobody has taken it.
state.claimedHint: Claimed by an agent; the form has not been submitted yet.
state.orphanedHint: Pull queue, yet the item is neither queued nor actively held — the hold expired and nothing returned it to the queue.
state.not_queuedHint: The target pool is push: there is no queue item for this record.
state.unknownHint: The pool configuration is not in cache — the state could not be derived and nothing was assumed.

col.ageHint: Time since the wrap-up was dispatched.
col.overdueHint: The deadline passed and the item is still recorded — a sign the expiry sweep did not run.

group.unassignedHint: Item with no assigned agent — unexpected in an internal queue.

errors.conflictTerminal: This item had already been closed — nothing was changed.
errors.conflictInFlight: Another close of this item is already under way — nothing was changed.

history.title: Wrap-up history
history.info: How disposition items ended over the period. For who owes one right now, see Monitor › Pending work.
history.errorBackend: The query failed on the server — what you see below is NOT zero, it is missing data.
history.emptyHint: No disposition item was closed within the selected window.
history.avgNote: The average counts submitted wrap-ups only: the duration of an expired item measures abandonment, not work.

col.avgFillHint: Average of submitted items only — the real after-call work time.
